prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1127; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and intermittent headaches radiating to the base of the skull. Physical examination revealed restricted cervical range of motion, paraspinal muscle tenderness, and mild muscle guarding without neurological deficit. Cervical radiographs were unremarkable for fracture or malalignment. The working diagnosis was cervical strain with associated myofascial pain.

Over the course of care, the patient attended 18 visits. Treatment included manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, a graded therapeutic exercise program focused on deep neck flexor and scapular stabilization, and home exercise instruction. Modalities such as moist heat and ultrasound were used early in the course for symptom control. Gradual improvement in range of motion, pain intensity, and daily functional tolerance was documented across the treatment period.

At discharge, the patient reported residual occasional stiffness with prolonged computer use but had returned to work and independent daily activities. Continued self-directed home exercise and ergonomic modifications were recommended. Follow-up on an as-needed basis was advised should symptoms recur.
